notes: Verified 2026-10-09 (omp v18.8.6): PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=/sandbox/agent is honored for config.yml, models.yml, mcp.json, AGENTS.md and skills/ (default profile only - never use --profile).
omp ALSO writes outside the agent dir to its config root ($HOME/.omp: logs/, run/). PI_CONFIG_DIR=agent/.omp (joined onto HOME) moves it to /sandbox/agent/.omp so read-only-HOME policies work.
The embedded Rust addon is extracted at BUILD time to PI_NATIVES_DIR=/usr/local/lib/omp/natives; the natives loader ignores PI_CONFIG_DIR.
mcp.json differs from pi despite the same file name: timeout is MILLISECONDS (pi: seconds), header env refs must be ${VAR} (pi also accepts $VAR), use "type": "http".
Single Bun binary: provider profiles must list /usr/local/bin/omp in binaries, or all egress is denied.
Startup probes model-catalog hosts (zenmux.ai, api.venice.ai, hyper.charm.land, catalog.stencil.so, api.kilo.ai, ...); these are denied by policy and harmless.
models file is models.yml (YAML) vs pi's models.json; payloads are per-harness. Skills and AGENTS.md role text are shared.
